display.purpose: The wordmark in the header. At most one step above the largest figure.

headline.purpose: Stat-card figures — always money, always Plex Mono with tabular numbers.

title.purpose: Card h3s and column heads; quiet uppercase graphite capsules.

hand.purpose: Tagline, note heads, auto-tag stamp. The personal hand on the page.

shadows.name: soft-paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards, notes, the brand mark, assistant bubbles. Low, warm, desk-like.

motion.name: note-ink
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: the assistant note settles like ink onto paper.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Grids collapse to two columns; header wraps.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Grids collapse to one column; tables scroll inside .table-wrap.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a card area; vermilion so it stays rare.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--paper, 9px); padding: 8px 16px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--accent, #b03a24); color: #fff6ec; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s, transform 0.06s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #98311e); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b03a24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The quiet alternative; paper surface so the primary keeps the room.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { appearance: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--paper-vivid, #fdf8ee); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2d7bf); color: var(--ink-soft, #5a4f41); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink, #2b241d); border-color: var(--rule, #d7caac); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b03a24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Pill navigation; the active tab tints vermilion, and Assistant sits last as the quietest entry.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Ledger</button><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" type="button">Slips</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Assistant</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2d7bf); background: var(--paper-vivid, #fdf8ee); color: var(--ink-soft, #5a4f41); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #2b241d); border-color: var(--rule, #d7caac); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b03a24); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-active { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(176, 58, 36, 0.12)); border-color: rgba(176, 58, 36, 0.4); color: var(--accent-hover, #98311e); }

components.name: Pigment Chip
components.description: Tints a money category or source from its tube color; ink-blocked text keeps 4.5:1 on paper.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2d7bf); color: var(--graphite, #6f6350); background: var(--paper-inset, #eee4cf); } .ds-pill-source { color: var(--tone-commission, #49409f); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pig-commission, #5b52c4) 12%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pig-commission, #5b52c4) 34%, transparent); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Vivid paper field; focus turns ink with a 3px vermilion-tinted ring and a vermilion caret.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Description<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. Pet portrait, 12×12"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 12px; color: var(--graphite, #6f6350); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-input { font: inherit; background: var(--paper-vivid, #fdf8ee); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2d7bf); color: var(--ink, #2b241d); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 11px; outline: none; caret-color: var(--accent, #b03a24); transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--graphite, #6f6350); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--ink, #2b241d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(176, 58, 36, 0.14); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Vivid paper card; the figure is the headline — Plex Mono 27px, ink, leading over a graphite uppercase title.
components.html:
Net, this month

+$1,280

money in minus money out
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--paper-vivid, #fdf8ee); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2d7bf); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(43, 36, 29, 0.07), 0 8px 20px rgba(43, 36, 29, 0.06); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 2px; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 11.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; color: var(--graphite, #6f6350); font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-big { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace); font-size: 27px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #2b241d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-card-hint { color: var(--graphite, #6f6350); font-size: 12.5px; margin: 5px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); }

components.name: Assistant Note
components.description: The AI's home is a note on the desk, revealed by the one authored motion moment.
components.html:
A note from your assistant

You're 2 wells away from healthy this month.
components.css: .ds-note { background: var(--paper-vivid, #fdf8ee); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2d7bf); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(43, 36, 29, 0.07), 0 8px 20px rgba(43, 36, 29, 0.06); animation: ds-note-ink 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-note-ink { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); filter: blur(3px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: blur(0); } } .ds-note-head { margin: 0 0 2px; font-family: var(--font-hand, 'Caveat', cursive); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-soft, #5a4f41); line-height: 1.15; } .ds-note-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #5a4f41); font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Karla', sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Auto-Tag Stamp
components.description: A hand-stamped 'auto' beside the slip: Caveat, teal ink, 1px border, pitched -1deg.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-hand, 'Caveat', cursive); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--tone-other, #22665b); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--pig-other, #2f7d6f) 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pig-other, #2f7d6f) 9%, transparent); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 5px; margin-left: 7px; transform: rotate(-1deg); vertical-align: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
StudioLedger is the little ledger that lives on an artist's desk — a daylight-studio relic made of warm ivory paper, hand-inked annotations, and the tube colors of real pigments. Money is not a dashboard's abstraction here; it is something measured by hand, sources labeled in their own paint colors, running totals set in typewriter-style numerals on a ruled page. The whole screen is one long paper ground with painters' wash tints bleeding into the bars.

The voice is warm and candid, unhurried, and a little worn-in: a note from an assistant reads like a friend writing by hand, an auto-categorized slip carries a rubber-stamped "auto", and the tagline is script, not marketing type. Density is calm — one column of cards over a ~1120px measure, figures large enough to read across the room — and the interface never performs "artiness": it behaves like a ledger that happens to be painted. The AI does not headline anything; it is an assistant note beneath the charts and a quiet tab at the end of the row.

The composition gap from the previous AI-SaaS build is deliberate: no dark slate, no glow, no orbit-graph hero. StudioLedger is a light scene (daylight studio), and the palette carries that scene, never the category.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory paper ground with a faint woven tooth; card surfaces one step vivid, inset panels one step shadowed.
Income sources as tube colors (commission violet, Etsy ochre, Patreon rose, other teal); income warm, spending cool.
All money in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals — numbers read as measurements, never as decoration.
Hand script (Caveat) reserved for the tagline, note heads, and the auto-tag stamp; prose is Karla.
One action colour (a vermilion red) per card; pigment tints belong to sources and statuses only.
Single authored motion moment: the assistant's note reveals like ink settling onto paper.
Ruled ledger edges (hairlines) instead of card borders stronger than the paper line.

rules.name: The Tube Rule
rules.body: A pigment belongs to a source, a status, or a sign — never to decoration. Tints are rendered as the pigment at 11–13% with a 34% border and an ink-blocked text tone (each ≥ 4.5:1 on paper). If a color is not a source, a status, or the one accent, it is not on the page.

rules.name: The One-Action Rule
rules.body: One filled button per card area. Vermilion marks the single thing you can do right now; everything else is ghost, link, or the paper itself.

rules.name: The Ink-And-Sum Rule
rules.body: If it is a number that means money, it is Plex Mono with tabular-nums. If it is a personal aside (tagline, note, stamp), it is Caveat. Everything else is Karla. A number rendered in Karla reads as prose; a note rendered in Karla loses the hand that wrote it.

rules.name: The No-Costume Rule
rules.body: No hard offset block shadows, no glow, no arbitrary blur pills. If an element needs to lift, it gets the soft shadow or a warmer paper — nothing that fights the desk scene.

dos: Do tint chips and bars from the source pigment (#5b52c4, #bd8a2e, #c75d8a, #2f7d6f) with a 12%-ish transparent fill, 34% border, and an ink-blocked text tone.
Do set every money amount in Plex Mono with tabular-nums at the right edge of its column.
Do write the tagline, note heads, and the auto stamp in Caveat; everything else in Karla.
Do reserve vermilion (#b03a24) for the one action on a card and the selection/focus signals.
Do keep a leader line — border-bottom: var(--rule) — under the header and the tabs to close each ruled band.
donts: Don't darken the scene. The ground stays ivory paper (#f6efe0); no dark mode, no slate, no glow — the scene is a daylight studio.
Don't promote the assistant above the charts or past the last tab. AI is the quiet note and the end-of-row tab.
Don't use a system display face, gradient text, or emoji glyphs as icons; the mark is an authored SVG brushwork gesture.
Don't add kickers/eyebrows above headings, five-card icon rows, or hero-metric hero templates — the stat grid carries the story.
Don't set hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0) or zero-blur shadows; lift comes from the Soft Paper Lift token or tone.
Don't let a table, chart, or any surface push the page wider than the viewport — wrap tight, scroll wide.
